dct_title_s: Nigeria - FEWSNET IPC Acute Food Security Classifications over Time: A Public Health and Food Security Synthesis Report with Corresponding Data
dct_description_sm: This report explores food insecurity in Nigeria in the context of urbanization and demographic change. A comparison of changing acute food security measures (IPC) from January and February 2010-2018 accompanies the report. The authors, Jordan Burnett, Leah Nadel, Victoria Santiago, and Arline Tarazona, completed their research in partial fulfillment of Public Health coursework in Medical Geography, for Spring 2018, at Drew University. Dr. Lisa Jordan edited the report and supplemented their work with additional spatial data.
